roles.source: Quiq lifecycle events and immutable daily export manifests
roles.target: Canonical SMS lifecycle facts and reverse-compatible export rows

transformClassification.evidenceBasis: The profile declares version-controlled forward and reverse mappings with nine fixed parity fields; readiness still requires pinned implementation and Test evidence.

schemaShape: lifecycle fact graph and reverse-compatible rows
normalizationRules: UTC timestamps, provider status and phone-location policy
mappingExpressions: versioned forward and reverse lifecycle SQL
vocabularySelections: existing Lexicon message and lifecycle terms

invariants.description: Omitted optional JSON fields materialize as typed nulls without schema inference drift
Lifecycle enrichment applies the declared phone-location policy consistently
Daily export uses an explicit UTC half-open time window
All nine declared lifecycle fields survive reverse mapping after normalization
Hydrated objects exactly reconcile with the immutable source manifest

repositories.purpose: SMS product, Quiq lifecycle and export contracts

discoveryProbes.description: Locate lifecycle, enrichment and reverse-export contracts
Resolve immutable full-day export manifest and mapping
Resolve active Spark and deployed package provenance
Read sanitized status and parity aggregates

identityRules: Derive stable lifecycle identity from provider correlation and event role without reporting message or phone identifiers
endpointRules: Every lifecycle edge references a declared message vertex
Dangling endpoint count must equal zero
